name: BloodHound / SharpHound
description: Graphs AD ACLs and group nesting to answer 'shortest path to Domain Admins' -- equally a defender's tool and an attacker's, and the way shadow admins are found.

name: Certipy
description: Enumerates AD CS certificate template misconfigurations and flags them by ESC number -- certipy find -vulnerable is the standing-exposure audit.

name: repadmin
description: Built-in replication tool. /showobjmeta dumps per-attribute replication metadata that survives Security log clearing and exposes DCShadow.

name: Reset-KrbTgt-Password script
description: Community-maintained krbtgt reset script that enforces the wait period between resets and handles read-only DC krbtgt accounts correctly.

name: AzureHound
description: BloodHound's Entra ID collector. Enumerates tenant objects and relationships through legitimate APIs, so it need not run from inside the victim network at all.

name: Certipy / Certify
description: AD CS enumeration and abuse tooling. Also the practical defensive audit path -- certipy find -vulnerable enumerates the ESC misconfigurations before an attacker does.

name: Impacket / secretsdump
description: Python implementations of Windows network protocols. secretsdump.py performs both remote DCSync and offline NTDS.dit parsing -- recognizable by the service-creation and authentication traces it leaves.

name: Invoke-Obfuscation
description: PowerShell obfuscation framework. Its output has a recognizable shape -- dense backtick-splitting, layered format strings, and compression stacked under encoding.

name: Mimikatz
description: The reference credential-theft tool. Listed here so analysts recognize its command syntax in logs -- sekurlsa::logonpasswords, lsadump::dcsync, misc::memssp each map to a distinct technique in this academy.

name: Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK
description: Revoke-MgUserSignInSession for forced token revocation, plus the Get-Mg cmdlets used to audit app registrations, OAuth grants and credentials.

name: CyberChef
description: Recipe-chaining decode workbench. From Base64 then Decode text UTF-16LE handles the simple PowerShell case; add Gunzip or Raw Inflate when compression is layered on.

name: Atomic Red Team
description: Small scoped tests mapped to ATT&CK techniques, for turning 'detection exists' into 'detection validated'.

name: ATT&CK Navigator
description: Renders coverage as a colour-coded layer over the ATT&CK matrix, exportable and version-controllable as a JSON layer file.

name: DetectionLab
description: Pre-instrumented Active Directory lab with Sysmon, logging, and an EDR already deployed -- a practice environment where the telemetry this academy relies on already exists.

name: MISP
description: Open-source threat intelligence platform for storing, correlating, and sharing indicators -- including within sector-specific sharing communities.

name: MpCmdRun
description: Microsoft Defender's command-line interface. -GetFiles produces a full diagnostic package including detection history; -Restore -ListAll enumerates quarantined items locally.

name: Sigma
description: Tool-agnostic detection rule format with converters for most SIEM and EDR query languages -- write the logic once, deploy it anywhere.

name: Sysmon
description: System Monitor. Event ID 1 process creation with full lineage, 3 network, 6 driver load, 7 image load, 10 process access, 11 file create, 15 ADS, 19-21 WMI, 22 DNS.

name: libpff
description: Parses PST and OST files -- the OST case matters when a mailbox has been wiped server-side and the endpoint cache is the only surviving copy.

name: MFCMAPI
description: Direct access to underlying MAPI properties, which is how inbox rules hidden from the Outlook interface are found.

name: AmcacheParser
description: Parses Amcache.hve including its SHA-1 hashes -- the one execution-adjacent artifact that survives deletion of the binary and enables threat-intel pivoting.

name: AppCompatCacheParser
description: Extracts ShimCache entries preserving their most-recent-first ordering, from a live system or an offline SYSTEM hive.

name: Autoruns
description: Enumerates roughly a hundred autostart locations with signature verification -- 'Hide Microsoft entries' plus 'Verify code signatures' collapses it to a reviewable list.

name: EvtxECmd
description: Normalizes Windows event logs into timeline-friendly CSV, and parses recovered EVTX fragments as well as intact files.

name: JLECmd
description: Jump List parser for AutomaticDestinations and CustomDestinations, resolving AppIDs and exposing DestList access counts and ordering.

name: LECmd
description: LNK file parser exposing target path, size, embedded target MAC times, volume serial number, and originating machine name.

name: MFTECmd
description: Eric Zimmerman's $MFT, $J and $Boot parser, outputting SI and FN timestamp sets side by side plus the SI<FN, Copied, and uSecZeros flags used throughout Level 4.

name: PECmd
description: Prefetch parser recovering all eight execution timestamps, run counts, and the referenced-file list that reveals what a since-deleted binary touched.

name: ProcDump
description: Sysinternals process dump utility. A legitimate troubleshooting tool routinely repurposed for LSASS credential dumping -- recognize procdump -ma lsass.exe in command lines.

name: Process Explorer / Process Hacker
description: Live process tree inspection with signature verification -- the fastest way to spot a misparented svchost.exe or a child of lsass.exe on a running host.

name: python-cim
description: Parses the WMI CIM repository (OBJECTS.DATA) offline -- the only route to WMI event subscription persistence when the host cannot be queried live.

name: Registry Explorer / RECmd
description: Registry hive browser and command-line parser handling dirty hives, transaction log replay, and deleted-key recovery from hive slack.

name: ShellBagsExplorer / SBECmd
description: Reconstructs the folder tree a user browsed in Explorer from UsrClass.dat and NTUSER.DAT -- including paths that no longer exist.

name: Sysinternals Suite
description: Process Explorer, Autoruns, ProcMon, SDelete and the rest -- signed Microsoft tooling that appears in both legitimate administration and intrusions.

name: F-Response
description: Mounts remote disks and memory as read-only local volumes over the network, so existing forensic tools work against a live remote host.

name: Kansa
description: PowerShell Remoting framework for fleet-wide sweeps, shipping frequency-analysis scripts that stack results across thousands of hosts to surface outliers.

name: KAPE
description: Targeted artifact collection at speed. Targets define what to collect, Modules define what to run against it -- a full triage set in minutes rather than a full disk image in hours.

name: osquery
description: Exposes the operating system as a relational database queryable with SQL -- useful for standing inventory and state questions across mixed platforms.

name: Redline
description: Mandiant's memory capture plus triage collector with a built-in analysis GUI, suiting responders who need capture and review in one tool.

name: Velociraptor
description: Endpoint visibility platform with its own query language (VQL) for real-time hunting and scheduled collection across an estate.

name: bulk_extractor
description: Scans images for features -- email addresses, URLs, card numbers -- rather than whole files, which is often more directly useful for scoping.

name: DeXRAY
description: Decodes quarantined files from Defender and other AV products back to their original bytes for offline analysis.

name: EVTXtract
description: Recovers individual EVTX event records from unallocated space and slack after a log has been cleared.

name: INDXRipper
description: Extracts $I30 directory index entries including slack, recovering filenames and $FN timestamps of deleted files after their MFT records were reused.

name: LogFileParser
description: Parses the NTFS $LogFile transaction log, recovering redo/undo records for recent filesystem operations -- the highest-resolution and most perishable disk artifact.

name: PhotoRec / TestDisk
description: Signature-based file carving with broad format support, for recovering content when the filesystem record is gone.

name: scalpel / foremost
description: Classic header/footer file carvers. Simpler than PhotoRec and easy to point at a custom signature set when you know exactly what you are looking for.

name: SDelete
description: Sysinternals secure-deletion utility. Legitimate and signed, which is why it appears in intrusions -- and why its execution artifacts and HKCU\Software\Sysinternals\SDelete EULA key are worth hunting.

name: Streams
description: Sysinternals utility that recursively enumerates NTFS alternate data streams -- the streams dir /R shows one directory at a time.

name: Belkasoft RAM Capturer
description: Free GUI memory acquisition, an alternative when a responder needs something simple and fast.

name: DumpIt
description: Single-executable memory capture requiring no arguments -- useful when a non-specialist has to run it over the phone.

name: FTK Imager
description: Disk imaging with a memory-capture feature, convenient when it is already part of a standard triage kit.

name: Magnet RAM Capture
description: Free GUI memory capture with a small footprint, usable without command-line setup.

name: Volatility 3
description: The reference memory analysis framework. pslist/psscan, malfind, ldrmodules, netscan, threads, mutantscan, dumpfiles and the rootkit plugins used across Level 3.

name: WinPmem
description: Open-source kernel-driver memory acquisition -- the most commonly cited baseline live-capture tool.

name: YARA
description: Pattern-matching rules for identifying malware families in files and memory. Use 'wide ascii' for memory, where .NET and PowerShell hold strings as UTF-16.

name: nfdump
description: Lightweight NetFlow capture and analysis, a common alternative to SiLK for flow-based investigation.

name: RITA
description: Beaconing detection through statistical analysis of connection inter-arrival timing and byte consistency in Zeek logs.

name: SiLK
description: NetFlow/IPFIX collection and analysis toolset for volume analysis, lateral movement mapping, and long-window retention.

name: Wireshark
description: Packet capture and protocol analysis, for the cases where flow metadata is not enough and full payload is available.

name: Zeek
description: Network monitoring producing protocol-parsed logs including conn.log, dns.log and ssl.log with JA3 fingerprints.

name: Plaso / log2timeline
description: Super timeline engine. log2timeline parses an image once into a storage file; psort then filters and exports it repeatedly in seconds.

name: The Sleuth Kit
description: fls and mactime produce a filesystem timeline via bodyfile format in minutes -- filesystem metadata only, but fast.

name: Timeline Explorer
description: Viewer for large forensic CSV output with column filtering, search, and tagging across millions of rows -- the tagging is what preserves analytical work.
